title: Be authorised to take water
what: Take water from a prescribed water resource only as authorised under s 105 or as part of a water allocation (a water licence).

sources.title: Landscape South Australia Act 2019 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not take water from a prescribed watercourse, lake or well or take surface water from a surface water prescribed area— (a) unless the person is— (i) — (A) authorised to do so under section 105; or (B) taking the water as part of a water allocation that relates to the relevant water resource;

administration.who: Chief Executive of the Department administering the Landscape South Australia Act 2019 (SA)

sources.title: Landscape South Australia Act 2019 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 25, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Chief Executive means the Chief Executive of the Department and includes a person for the time being acting in that position;

reach.condition: if it takes water from a regulated river, aquifer or other water source, beyond basic landholder rights
